access.notes: Any package supporting B3LYP functional, effective core potentials (Stuttgart/Dresden ECP for Pt), and 6-31G* basis set. Examples: ORCA (https://orcaforum.kofo.mpg.de), PySCF (https://pyscf.org), NWChem (https://nwchemgit.github.io), Psi4 (https://psicode.org).

resources.name: NBO analysis tool or built-in population analysis

access.notes: Used to compute Wiberg bond indices and NPA charges. Available in many quantum chemistry programs natively (ORCA, PySCF) or via standalone NBO6 (https://nbo6.chem.wisc.edu).
Multiwfn (http://sobereva.com/multiwfn) or Critic2 (https://aoterodelaroza.github.io/critic2) to locate bond critical points and extract electron densities from wavefunction files.
